This topic is part of the AQA A-Level Design Technology specification.

Design Communication appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Design Communication in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The AQA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Design Communication.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
